headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: BJP wins Nandigram by-poll by record margin of over 1.22L votes.
Telangana Sets One-Month Deadline to Clear Pending GO 59 Land Regularisation Applications.
NDA will allot 34 pc tickets to Backward Classes in local body polls, says Andhra Pradesh CM.
KTR says no one bigger than the Constitution, seeking Gyanesh Kumar’s removal.
bullets_ur: BJP ne Nandigram by-poll mein 1.22L se zyada votes ke record margin se jeet haasil kar li.
Telangana ne GO 59 ke tehat pending land regularisation darkhwaston ko niptane ke liye ek mah ki deadline de di.
Andhra Pradesh CM ka kehna hai ke NDA maqami idaron ke intikhabat mein Backward Classes ko 34% tickets degi
KTR ka kehna hai ke Aeen se bara koi nahi, Gyanesh Kumar ko hatane ka mutalba.
